bugClass: FlashLoopAdapter._start trusts msg.sender.isModuleEnabled(address(this)); a fake contract returns true, then caller-supplied swapRouter.call runs execTransactionFromModule on real Safes that enabled the adapter

Spoofable Safe-module auth: open()/close() trust ISafe(msg.sender).isModuleEnabled(address(this)); _swap() then performs an attacker-controlled router.call that invokes execTransactionFromModule on victim Safes that enabled the adapter.

FlashLoopAdapter.open authenticates by asking msg.sender whether the adapter is an enabled module, then _swap calls a caller-supplied router with caller-supplied calldata, so an attacker can make any Safe that enabled the module execute as itself.

open() treats msg.sender as the Safe because it asks msg.sender whether the adapter is an enabled module, then _swap calls a caller-supplied swapRouter with caller-supplied calldata, so the attacker points that call at a real Safe that enabled the module and drains it via execTransactionFromModule.
open()/close() self-attest the caller as a Safe via isModuleEnabled, then _swap calls a caller-supplied swapRouter with arbitrary calldata (victim Safe execTransactionFromModule)
